Article Title: Congress: New name for opposition, sign of desperation
Article Text: NEW DELHI: Congress lashed out at PM Narendra Modi Saturday over his remarks on "dimagi Naxals", calling it a sign of desperation.Congress' RS MP Jairam Ramesh said, "First he called his opponents 'urban naxals.' Now he calls them 'dimagi naxals.' It is a sure sign of his desperation. It is a separate matter that he ends up doing whatever these so-called 'urban naxals' or now 'dimagi naxals' are demanding or advocating. " Ramesh later said two or three years ago, the PM had dubbed his political opponents "urban Naxals"."A question was then asked in Parliament on the definition of urban Naxals, and the home minister said there is no definition of urban Naxals. Today, the PM is calling his political opponents 'dimagi Naxals' from the Red Fort. Two years ago, he had said the demand for a caste census was urban Naxals' thought. A year later, the Modi govt will get a caste census conducted. First, abuse them and then accept whatever their demands are. "
Article Summary: Congress' RS MP Jairam Ramesh said, "First he called his opponents 'urban naxals.' Now he calls them 'dimagi naxal' It is a sure sign of his desperation," he said. Two years ago, he had said the demand for a caste census was urban Naxals' thought.

Article Title: PM Modi puts women's quota back on table, makes fresh pitch to opposition
Article Text:
PM Narendra Modi

New Delhi: PM Narendra Modi chose his Independence Day address Saturday to give a strong indication of of his govt's intent to revive the Constitution amendment bill to implement one-third reservation for women in Lok Sabha and assemblies, with a 50% jump in their overall strength from 2029, urging all political parties to ensure that it was rolled out as soon as possible.While it was widely speculated in political circles that govt was keen to revive the bill, which was defeated by the opposition in April, Modi put on record that the matter was on the agenda, boosting the prospect of Parliament being summoned as early as next month."Today, standing here beneath the shadow of the Tricolour on the ramparts of Red Fort, I pray to and urge all political parties to acknowledge the power of women. Let's step forward to uphold their dignity and ensure our mothers and sisters get 33% representation in assemblies and Lok Sabha as soon as possible," he said.What has enhanced the likelihood of the bill being passed is the defection of 20 Lok Sabha MPs from Trinamool Congress and six from Sena UBT to NDA and DMK's assiduous efforts, visible in the recently concluded session, to keep away from the opposition's ranks after Congress ditched it in Tamil Nadu to ally with Vijay-led TVK.NCP SP is being seen as another potential support.Congress accused Modi of making a "dishonest pitch" for women's reservation in his address, saying 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam' was unanimously passed in Sept 2023, but BJP govt's "double standards" and "hypocrisy" had made sure it didn't come into effect from 2024.Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh, in a post on X, said the party had stood firm on its stand to implement women's reservation from the 2029 Lok Sabha elections by retaining the current strength of 543 seats in LS.Modi said women served as public representatives in large numbers in panchayats to municipalities and municipal corporations, referring to their salience in local bodies on the back of reservation.Despite several efforts to reserve seats in Lok Sabha and assemblies, the idea had fallen victim to political battles for over 40 years, he said.He called it the need of the hour and told parties to join the cause. "You also take the credit, you also take the fame, but give rights to my mothers and sisters," he said, reiterating the pitch he had made before the failed bid last time.The monsoon session has not been prorogued, keeping open the possibility of govt summoning Parliament.
Article Summary: PM Narendra Modi chose his Independence Day address Saturday to give a strong indication of his govt's intent to revive the Constitution amendment bill. Modi put on record that the matter was on the agenda, boosting the prospect of Parliament being summoned as early as next month.

Article Title: Asish Banerjee, former Bengal deputy speaker, found hanging at TMC party office
Article Text:
Ashis Banerjee (File Photo) (Image Credit: X)

Who was Asish Banerjee?





KOLKATA: Asish Banerjee, the former deputy speaker of the West Bengal assembly, was found dead on Sunday morning at a Trinamool Congress office in Rampurhat, Birbhum district.His body was found hanging and was sent for a post-mortem examination, police said. The circumstances surrounding his death are not yet clear.According to news agency PTI, a purported suicide note was also recovered from office located near his residence.Banerjee served as deputy speaker during TMC chief Mamata Banerjee’s tenure as West Bengal chief minister. He was a five-time MLA from Rampurhat.Earlier this year, Banerjee resigned as chairman of the TMC's Birbhum district core committee.Also read: ‘TMC not functioning properly’: Resignation, poll defeat cast shadow before Asish Banerjee’s death "I will continue to remain as the party's general member," the former Rampurhat MLA had said.Banerjee had also said he was in agreement with former Lavpur MLA Abhijit Sinha, who resigned from the Birbhum district core committee, alleging that it was not functioning in accordance with its political responsibilities during the assembly election.Both Banerjee and Sinha lost the assembly polls.The BJP won six of Birbhum's 11 assembly constituencies in the 2026 polls, while the TMC won five.In the 2021 assembly election, the TMC had won 10 seats in the district and the BJP one.Banerjee, a veteran TMC leader, represented Rampurhat in the state assembly continuously from 2001 to 2026.He served as deputy speaker and also held ministerial portfolios, including school education and agriculture, in the Mamata Banerjee government.He contested the 2026 assembly election from Rampurhat on a TMC ticket but lost to BJP's Dhruva Saha by more than 24,000 votes.Party sources said Banerjee had not been particularly active in politics following his electoral defeat.
Article Summary: Asish Banerjee found dead at Trinamool Congress office in Rampurhat, Birbhum district. The circumstances surrounding his death are not yet clear. A purported suicide note was also recovered from his residence. He served as deputy speaker during TMC chief MamataBanerjee's tenure as West Bengal chief minister.

Article Text: New Delhi: A 12-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted by her father in northeast Delhi. He has been arrested, police said.The case came to light after a complaint was received from the girl’s mother after the child confided to her. Police spoke to the girl and took her statement before apprehending her father and questioning him. He allegedly confessed to the crime.The child underwent medical examination, and the local child welfare committee was informed. A case was registered under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (Pocso) Act.In a similar case, in July, a man was accused of sexually assaulting his 13-year-old daughter in northwest Delhi while his wife and son were away. In another incident, a 14-year-old girl had filed a complaint at a central Delhi police station alleging that her father had repeatedly sexually assaulted her over two weeks while her mother was away.
Article Summary: A 12-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted by her father in northeast Delhi. The case came to light after a complaint was received from the girl’s mother. Police spoke to the girl and took her statement before apprehending her father. He allegedly confessed to the crime.

Article Title: Rahul Gandhi to visit Pune on Aug 22
Article Text:
Pune:





Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi will visit Pune on Aug 22 to participate in ‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ initiative by the Congress.Announcing Rahul’s visit to Pune, state Congress president Harshwardhan Sapkal on Friday said Gandhi will interact with students during his visit. “Before Pune, Rahul participated in ‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ initiative in Kota, Dehradun and Prayagraj cities where he spoke to the students to understand their issues. In a similar manner, he will interact with girl students in Pune to understand the challenges being faced by them in regards with the education system,” Sapkal said.Rahul’s interaction with the younger generation in Pune will take place against the backdrop of the recent Cockroach Janata Party’s protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi where he and other opposition members raised the issue of violence against the protesters. During his visit to Pune, the Congress leader is expected to target the centre on the recent NEET paper leak issue.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi will visit Pune on Aug 22 to participate in ‘Chhatron ki Goonj’ initiative by the Congress. During his visit to Pune, the Congress leader is expected to target the centre on the recent NEET paper leak issue.

Article Title: Carpenter robbed of ₹30,000 at knifepoint in Ganeshpeth
Article Text: Nagpur: A 32-year-old carpenter from Jharkhand was robbed of ₹30,000 at knifepoint by three unidentified men near Empress Mall Gate in Ganeshpeth on Wednesday afternoon.Complainant Bablu Gopi Mistri Sharma, a resident of Mehernagar, Wathoda, was travelling in an e-rickshaw towards the railway station to return to his native village in Dhanbad when the accused intercepted him around 3.10 pm on Aug 13.Two of them attacked Sharma and threatened to kill him with a knife while the third forcibly snatched the cash from his pocket. The trio then fled on a two-wheeler. Sharma, who works as a carpenter, lodged a complaint the same evening.Police have registered a case under relevant sections of BNS. The accused remain absconding.
Article Summary: A 32-year-old carpenter from Jharkhand was robbed of ₹30,000 at knifepoint by three unidentified men. Bablu Gopi Mistri Sharma was travelling in an e-rickshaw towards the railway station to return to his native village in Dhanbad.

Article Title: Man ends life near railway station
Article Text:
Nagpur:





An unidentified man, aged around 40-45, allegedly ended life by hanging himself near the railway station. His body was found hanging from a tree on the road connecting the Metro station and the Platform 8 gate on Thursday.According to Govt Railway Police (GRP) sources, the man reportedly entered the railway station premises and climbed a tall tree in an isolated section adjoining a nullah.Officials said the man allegedly used the shirt he was wearing to hang himself. The fire brigade and forensic teams reached the spot and carried out the necessary procedures. The body was subsequently sent to Mayo Hospital for postmortem.Police said no injuries were found on the body. The deceased remains unidentified, and efforts are underway to establish his identity and contact his relatives.
Article Summary: Unidentified man, aged around 40-45, allegedly ended life by hanging himself near the railway station. His body was found hanging from a tree on the road connecting the Metro station and the Platform 8 gate on Thursday. Police said no injuries were found on the body.

Article Title: Utkrisht Seva Medal for Nashik top cop Sandeep Karnik
Article Text:
Sandeep Karnik

Nashik

:





Police commissioner Sandeep Karnik has been selected for the Utkrishta Seva Medal among several officers and personnel from Nashik, ahead of Independence Day The Utkrisht Seva Medal and Atiutkrisht Seva Medal are annual state-level honours instituted by the state govt to recognise outstanding, meritorious and dedicated service in the Maharashtra Police.Meanwhile, the President’s Medal for distinguished service has also been announced. Sub-inspectors Sanjay Waychale and Shekhar Fartale from Nashik city have been named recipients of the prestigious honour.17 other officers and personnel from Nashik city and Nashik Rural have been awarded the Ati Utkrist Seva Medal, including SP Nandkumar Thakur of the Maharashtra Police Academy and inspector Anchal Mudgal of the crime branch.Meanwhile, other officers honoured with the Utkrisht Seva Medal are inspectors Yuvraj Patki, Ankush Chintaman, Ashok Sharmale and Ranjit Nalawade.
Article Summary: Sandeep Karnik has been selected for the Utkrishta Seva Medal among several officers and personnel from Nashik, ahead of Independence Day. The President's Medal for distinguished service has also been announced. Sub-inspectors Sanjay Waychale and Shekhar Fartale have been named recipients of the prestigious honour.

Article Title: Two guest workers arrested for harassing woman, assaulting man
Article Text:
Chennai:





Two guest workers were arrested after they harassed a woman and attempted to assault a man who questioned them, in Uthiramerur in Kancheepuram district on Friday evening.According to police, Premkumar , 38 a daily wage labourer from Bazaar Road in Uthiramerur, witnessed two drunk men harassing a woman passing through the stretch. When Premkumar questioned their behaviour and intervened, an argument broke out. The two then attacked Premkumar. Residents in the neighbourhood rushed to the spot, overpowered the accused and handed them over to the local police.The accused were identified as Mohammed Thamees, 36, a native of Bihar , and Vishal Rajbar, 29, of Uttar Pradesh . Police said both were employed at a private iron and steel factory in Melpakkam village.Uthiramerur police registered a case, arrested the two men and produced them before a court, which remanded them in judicial custody.
Article Summary: Two guest workers were arrested after they harassed a woman and attempted to assault a man who questioned them. Residents in the neighbourhood rushed to the spot, overpowered the accused and handed them over to the local police. Police said both were employed at a private iron and steel factory in Melpakkam village.

Article Title: Guest worker dies in Metrowater tank demolition accident
Article Text:
Chennai:





A 28-year-old construction worker from West Bengal died after an iron rod fell on his head while demolishing the Metrowater’s water tank in Kodungaiyur.The deceased was identified as Jameer Hussain, a native of West Bengal, who was employed in the demolition of an unused one-lakh-litre water tank on Second Main Road in R V Nagar, Kodungaiyur. The demolition work had been in progress since July 20.According to the police, the accident occurred around 11am while workers were dismantling the structure. During the operation, an iron rod detached from the tank and fell on Jameer Hussain’s head, causing severe injuries. Fellow workers rushed him to Government Stanley Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead.The Kodungaiyur police registered a case.
Article Summary: The deceased was identified as Jameer Hussain, a native of West Bengal. He was employed in the demolition of an unused one-lakh-litre water tank on Second Main Road in R V Nagar, Kodungaiyur. The demolition work had been in progress since July 20.

Article Title: Coimbatore district police arrest man for derogatory posts about Lord Murugan
Article Text: COIMBATORE: The Periyanaickenpalayam police in Coimbatore district arrested a man on charges of posting derogatory comments about Hindu deity Lord Murugan on social media.Police arrested Michael of Rakkipalayam based on a complaint filed by M Shankar, who is the Narasimhanaickenpalayam union general secretary of Hindu Munnani. He alleged that Michael, through posts on Instagram and Facebook, used offensive words and made disparaging remarks targeting Lord Murugan that could disturb public peace and incite religious tension.Based on the complaint, police registered a case and arrested Michael, who is a TVK supporter.Cases were registered against Michael in several districts on the same issue, police sources said. Officials from the respective district police units have contacted the Coimbatore district police to coordinate efforts to arrest him.
Article Summary: Police arrested Michael of Rakkipalayam based on a complaint filed by M Shankar, who is the Narasimhanaickenpalayam union general secretary of Hindu Munnani. He alleged that Michael used offensive words and made disparaging remarks targeting Lord Murugan.

Article Title: Former TVK candidate Arun Kumar joins AIADMK
Article Text:
Salem





: Former TVK candidate M Arun Kumar on Saturday joined AIADMK after meeting party general secretary and former chief minister Edappadi K Palaniswami at the latter’s residence here.Arun Kumar, who had earlier served as the AIADMK union councillor in Ayothiapattinam, later joined TVK. He was initially announced as the TVK candidate in the Edappadi assembly constituency. His nomination was rejected after election officials found that the proposers listed in his papers could not be verified. The substitute candidate’s papers were also rejected on similar grounds, leaving TVK without a contender against Palaniswami in the constituency.By joining the AIADMK, Arun Kumar shifted political loyalties, strengthening the party’s grassroots presence in Salem district.(Photos: TOI)
Article Summary: Arun Kumar had earlier served as the AIADMK union councillor in Ayothiapattinam. He was initially announced as the TVK candidate in the Edappadi assembly constituency. His nomination was rejected after election officials found that the proposers listed in his papers could not be verified.

Article Title: Truck driver dies in road accident near Salem
Article Text: SALEM: A driver died in an accident involving a truck, a pickup van and a bus near Mecheri in Salem district on Wednesday. More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident.According to the Mecheri police, a TNSTC bus carrying 51 passengers was heading to Karur from Mettur when a speeding pickup van attempted to overtake it. “The pickup van collided head-on with a truck coming from the opposite direction,” said an officer at the Mecheri police station. The truck grazed the bus, shattering its windows and injuring more than 10 passengers seated near the windows.Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. The injured were rushed to govt hospitals in Mettur and Omalur.Fire service personnel, assisted by Mecheri police and residents, worked to move the damaged truck and pickup van to the roadside. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.The Mecheri police registered a case.
Article Summary: More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident. Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.

Article Title: Man arrested for violating Kaapa externment order in Mattancherry
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Mattancherry police arrested a 36-year-old man for allegedly violating an externment order issued against him under Section 15(1)(a) of Kerala Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act (Kaapa).The accused is Norbert P R, alias Chakkamadam Laiju, of Chakkamadam, Mattancherry. Police said he is accused in several criminal cases.The externment order, executed on Aug 11, barred him for six months from entering areas under the jurisdiction of Kochi deputy commissioner of police or engaging in any activity there.Despite the order, he was allegedly found near the Akshaya Centre on Jew Town Road on Aug 14. A Mattancherry police team comprising sub-inspector P C Jayaprasad and civil police officers Maheshan and Sarathmon arrested him.He was produced before a court and remanded in judicial custody.Meanwhile, Ernakulam Rural police externed a man accused in multiple cases under Kaapa on Friday.A 40-year-old man accused in several criminal cases has been externed for six months under Kaapa.Police said Haris, of Kunjattukara, Aluva, is accused in several cases registered within the Aluva and Edathala police station limits, including attempted murder, voluntarily causing grievous hurt, assault and criminal intimidation.Ernakulam Range DIG G H Yathish Chandra issued the order based on a report submitted by the Ernakulam Rural district police chief.The action followed his alleged involvement in a case registered by Aluva East police after an explosive material was thrown at a service bus at the Aluva private bus stand in late April.
Article Summary: Mattancherry police arrested a 36-year-old man for allegedly violating an externment order issued against him. Norbert P R, alias Chakkamadam Laiju, is accused in several criminal cases. He was produced before a court and remanded in judicial custody.

Article Title: BJP leaders stage parallel Independence Day programme, draws flak from Congress
Article Text:
Cochin Devaswom Board, which manages Thekkinkadu Maidan, has lodged a complaint with the city police commissioner seeking action against the event organisers

Thrissur

:





An Independence Day event attended allegedly by certain BJP functionaries and other activists at Thekkinkadu Maidan on Saturday protested the state govt’s decision not to sing the full version of Vande Mataram at its official programmes on the day.The protest, staged while the official district-level Independence Day celebrations were on nearby, drew sharp criticism from the Congress district brass. Sports minister O J Janeesh, who hoisted the Tricolour and delivered the Independence Day address at the district-level celebrations, also questioned the parallel event.Cochin Devaswom Board (CDB), which manages Thekkinkadu Maidan, has lodged a complaint with the city police commissioner seeking action against the event organisers as the board had decided not to permit such programmes at the venue located around Vadakkumnathan Temple, in compliance with a high court order.The organisers had neither obtained the board’s permission nor informed it about the programme, attended by more than 50 people.Interestingly, the programme was held under the banner Rashtra Raksha Samithi and participants carried only the national flag and not BJP flags. BJP state vice-president K K Aneeshkumar hoisted the national flag.Aneeshkumar claimed that Parliament had unanimously passed a resolution making the singing of Vande Mataram in its entirety mandatory at govt programmes.He alleged that the UDF govt, led by chief minister V D Satheesan, surrendered to Muslim League and Jama-at-e-Islami by deciding not to sing the song in full at Independence Day programmes.DCC president Joseph Tajet alleged that BJP insulted the sacrifices of the freedom fighters by organising a parallel Independence Day programme. Describing the protest as a challenge to democracy, Tajet said BJP functionaries were also attempting to circumvent legal action by organising the programme under the banner of Rashtra Raksha Samithi and not under the party banner.Janeesh alleged that BJP leaders may have chosen Independence Day for their protest because their party had no role in the country’s freedom movement.
Article Summary: Cochin Devaswom Board, which manages Thekkinkadu Maidan, has lodged a complaint with the city police commissioner seeking action against the event organisers. The organisers had neither obtained the board’s permission nor informed it about the programme, attended by more than 50 people.

Article Title: Kerala High Court seeks state reply on Indian Coffee House hiring row
Article Text:
Kerala High Court has sought instructions from the state govt by Monday

Kochi:





Kerala High Court has sought instructions from the state govt by Monday on a petition challenging a recruitment notification for the post of general workers at Indian Coffee House outlets.A bench of Justice Viju Abraham issued the directive on a petition filed by Suresh Kumar of Thrissur and Prakash P of Perinthalmanna challenging the notification issued by the Indian Coffee Board Workers’ Cooperative Society. The petitioners, who are currently employees at Indian Coffee House outlets, contended that a previous circular issued by the director of industries and commerce, who is also the functional registrar of the society, mandates a written test and interview for appointments to the general workers category. However, they alleged that the society issued the recruitment notification without authority and without following the prescribed procedures and guidelines. Accordingly, the court on Friday sought specific instructions from the state govt on the contentions raised by the petitioners and adjourned the case to Aug 17.
Article Summary: Kerala High Court has sought instructions from the state govt by Monday on a petition challenging a recruitment notification for the post of general workers at Indian Coffee House outlets. A bench of Justice Viju Abraham issued the directive on the petition filed by Suresh Kumar of Thrissur and Prakash P of Perinthalmanna.

Article Title: Cricketer Abishek Porel denied bail in alleged rape case
Article Text:
Abhishek Porel

What the complainant alleged

Court proceedings

Abishek Porel, the Delhi Capitals and Bengal cricketer, has been denied bail in an alleged rape case involving a medical student. A court on Friday sent him to judicial custody for 14 days.Porel was arrested on August 11 in Hooghly after being questioned over a complaint filed by a young woman, who accused him of rape, blackmail and other offences. He was later medically examined before being produced before the Chinsurah court.“There was a case lodged against him and a court order to arrest him. He was arrested late last night. He will be produced in court today," Hooghly (Rural) Superintendent of Police Kunar Bhushan Singh told PTI.According to the complaint, the woman said Porel entered into a relationship with her after promising to marry her. She alleged that after their relationship ended, he threatened to share private photographs of her. Police registered a case under 19 sections, with most of the charges being non-bailable.The complaint also refers to an alleged incident in Delhi on April 2, 2026. The woman claimed she was confined, not given food and deliberately kept isolated, leaving her physically weak and unable to walk properly.She further alleged that both families had discussed marriage, but the relationship later deteriorated after she allegedly found out about Porel’s involvement with other women.The case had previously reached the Calcutta High Court. Justice Saugata Bhattacharyya directed Magra Police Station to seize electronic devices, including Porel’s mobile phone, and submit an investigation report.At the August 11 hearing, police told the court that Porel had been arrested and would be produced before the Chinsurah court. The cricketer has now been denied bail and remanded to judicial custody for 14 days while the case proceeds.
Article Summary: Abhishek Porel denied bail in alleged rape case involving a medical student. Court remanded him to judicial custody for 14 days. Woman accused him of rape, blackmail and other offences. She alleged that after their relationship ended, he threatened to share private photographs of her.
